Firefox’s tab context menu provides a range of useful tools to help you manage and organize your tabs effectively. This menu is designed to give you quick access to common tab actions, enhancing your browsing experience. [[Template:contextmenu]] on a Firefox tab to open the tab context menu. Here’s an overview of the key available options.
;{for not fx140}{for not fx127}[[Image:Fx115TabMenu-CloseMultipleTabs]]{/for}{for fx127}[[Image:Tab context menu overview]]{/for}{/for}{for fx140}[[Image:unloadtabsmozilla]]{/for}

=Basic actions=
{for not fx140}
*'''New Tab:''' Open a [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]] quickly.
*'''Reload Tab:''' Refresh the selected tab to get the latest content.
*'''Mute Tab/Unmute Tab:''' [[Mute sound in Firefox tabs|Mute]] or unmute audio in the selected tab.
*'''Pin Tab/Unpin Tab:''' [[Pinned Tabs - keep favorite websites open and just a click away|Pin]] important tabs to keep them in place and unpin them when they are no longer needed.
*'''Duplicate Tab:''' Create a copy of the current tab, retaining the [[Browsing history in Firefox - View the websites you have visited|browsing history]].
*'''Bookmark Tab…:''' [[Bookmarks in Firefox|Bookmark]] the current tab for later reference.
{/for}
{for fx140}
*'''New Tab:''' Open a [[New Tab page in Firefox|New Tab page]] quickly.
*'''Reload Tab:''' Refresh the selected tab to get the latest content.
*'''Mute Tab/Unmute Tab:''' [[Mute sound in Firefox tabs|Mute]] or unmute audio in the selected tab.
*'''Unload Tab:''' [[Unload tabs to reduce system memory usage in Firefox|Unload]] the selected tab from memory.
*'''Pin Tab/Unpin Tab:''' [[Pinned Tabs - keep favorite websites open and just a click away|Pin]] important tabs to keep them in place and unpin them when they are no longer needed.
*'''Duplicate Tab:''' Create a copy of the current tab, retaining the [[Browsing history in Firefox - View the websites you have visited|browsing history]].
*'''Bookmark Tab…:''' [[Bookmarks in Firefox|Bookmark]] the current tab for later reference.
{/for}
=Move options=
*'''Move Tab:''' Relocate tabs within your window.
**Move to Start
**Move to End
**Move to New Window

=Device and sharing options=
*'''Send Tab to Device:''' Send the tab to another device [[Sync Firefox data|signed in]] to your Mozilla account.
*'''Share:''' Share the current tab via various methods.
*'''Open in New Container Tab:''' Open the tab in a different [[How to use Firefox containers|container]] for separation of activities. (Only shown if you have once installed an extension using containers.)

=Select and close options=
*'''Select All Tabs:''' Select all open tabs in the current window.
*'''Close Tab:''' Close the selected tab quickly.
{for fx127}
*'''Close Duplicate Tabs:''' Close tabs that are duplicates of the current one.
{/for}
*'''Close Multiple Tabs:''' Access options to close multiple tabs.
**Close Tabs to Right
**Close Tabs to Left
**Close Other Tabs
*'''Reopen Closed Tab:''' Reopen the last closed tab to retrieve any accidentally closed content.
{note}'''Note:''' If multiple tabs are selected, the chosen option is applied to all selected tabs (except for ''New Tab'' and ''Reopen Closed Tab'').{/note}
